annotations.title: List held content as one group per piece

description:
[read-only] The same held content as list_approvals, grouped by piece: the variants of one draft (or sharing a `group:<id>` label), with the axes they vary on (theme, hook, audio …), a tally (approved / redo / dropped / open) and each variant's state and slot time. `status` open (default) / redo / approved / dropped / all. Needs the explicit `approve` scope. Agency plan.
(Wraps GET /api/v2/approval-groups.)

brand.description: "personal" or a brand id (`brandId` is accepted too).

name: list_approval_groups
